newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Norilsk says needs Moscow's help to expand output.
newsitem.headline: Norilsk says needs Moscow's help to expand output.

text.p: Russian Norilsk Nickel's NKEL.RTS plan to become the world's largest nickel producer this year may depend on whether it gets state debt and other relief, a company spokesman said on Thursday.
"Realisation of the 1997 production plan strongly depends on the decisions of the government with regard to our needs to cut costs," Sergei Vetchinin said.
Norilsk -- a leading global producer of nickel, platinum, palladium and other metals -- aims to boost nickel output by 20 percent this year to 213,000 tonnes.

The financially-troubled company wants the government to offer it tax relief and to shoulder the cost of supporting its social infrastructure, which Norilsk officials have said consumes nearly 42 percent of annual revenue.
